about: LienCAM's credits: every project, library, vendored WebAssembly build, font, model, ported or adapted source, paper and shared resource LienCAM stands on. CREDITS.md is generated from this file by tools/release/credits.mjs; the licence duties for everything that ships are in THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md.

categories.title: Geometry and CAD kernels
categories.intro: The solid, mesh, sketch and polygon engines underneath every model and every toolpath.

categories.title: CAM algorithms and code we ported or adapted
categories.intro: Toolpath strategies other people worked out first and published so others could build on them.

categories.title: Rendering, UI and app platform
categories.intro: What draws the screen, holds the state, runs the models and turns a web app into a desktop app.

categories.title: Fonts and data
categories.intro: The typefaces in the interface and the letters LienCAM can cut.

categories.title: Machine control, standards and references
categories.intro: The controllers, standards, papers and published specifications that keep LienCAM honest about real machines.

categories.title: Tools we built it with
categories.intro: Not shipped with LienCAM, but it could not have been built without them.

entries.name: Open CASCADE Technology (OCCT)
entries.ships: Compiled into two vendored WebAssembly builds: occt-wasm (patched by us; patches in patches/) and occt-model (built with opencascade.js)
entries.role: The B-rep solid kernel: solids, fillets, booleans, defeature, STEP and IGES
entries.thanks: Decades of open solid-modelling work made a real CAD kernel possible in a browser - thank you to Open Cascade and every OCCT contributor.

entries.name: occt-wasm
entries.copyright: Copyright (c) Andy Mai and occt-wasm contributors
entries.ships: Vendored, locally patched WebAssembly package (vendor/occt-wasm/; the iges-history-stack build is the one installed, the three earlier builds stay in the source tree), loaded by the geometry worker
entries.role: The WebAssembly build and bindings of OCCT we patch and ship
entries.thanks: Thank you for a clean, reproducible OCCT-to-WASM build we could extend instead of starting from scratch.

entries.name: brepjs
entries.copyright: Copyright (c) Andy Mai and brepjs contributors
entries.ships: npm dependency, bundled into the geometry worker
entries.role: TypeScript B-rep modelling API over OCCT
entries.thanks: A thoughtful modelling API that saved us from writing kernel plumbing by hand.

entries.name: opencascade.js
entries.copyright: Copyright (c) Sebastian Alff and opencascade.js contributors
entries.ships: The builder of our second OCCT WebAssembly module (occt-model.wasm, vendored with its rebuild recipe)
entries.role: STEP import, topology queries and sectioning for the model kernel
entries.thanks: Thank you for pioneering OCCT in the browser; our STEP import stands on it.

entries.name: Emscripten
entries.copyright: Copyright (c) 2010-2014 Emscripten authors (see the AUTHORS file upstream)
entries.ships: Its JavaScript runtime support code is compiled into every WebAssembly module we ship (OCCT builds, PlaneGCS, Clipper2, Manifold, OpenCAMLib, ONNX Runtime)
entries.role: The compiler that turned C++ kernels into WebAssembly a browser can run
entries.thanks: Without Emscripten none of these C++ kernels would run in a browser - thank you.

entries.name: PlaneGCS (FreeCAD Sketcher solver)
entries.copyright: Copyright (c) 2011 Konstantinos Poulios and the FreeCAD contributors
entries.ships: Compiled into the @salusoft89/planegcs WebAssembly module, loaded in a worker
entries.role: The 2D constraint solver behind every sketch
entries.thanks: FreeCAD's sketch solver is the heart of LienCAM's constrained sketching - thank you to its authors.

entries.name: @salusoft89/planegcs
entries.ships: npm dependency; WebAssembly module loaded unmodified in a worker
entries.role: WebAssembly build and wrapper of PlaneGCS
entries.thanks: Thank you for packaging PlaneGCS so a web app can use it.

entries.name: Manifold (manifold-3d)
entries.copyright: Copyright (c) Emmett Lalish and Manifold contributors
entries.ships: npm dependency; WebAssembly module loaded unmodified
entries.role: Robust mesh booleans and repair (Mesh Lab, mesh edits)
entries.thanks: Booleans that simply do not fail - thank you, Emmett Lalish and contributors.

entries.name: Clipper2
entries.ships: Compiled into the clipper2-wasm WebAssembly module
entries.role: All 2D polygon offsetting, union and difference in toolpaths
entries.thanks: Nearly every 2D toolpath in LienCAM passes through Angus Johnson's Clipper - thank you.

entries.name: Clipper2-WASM (clipper2-wasm)
entries.ships: npm dependency; WebAssembly module loaded unmodified
entries.role: WebAssembly build of Clipper2
entries.thanks: Thank you for bringing Clipper2 to the web.

entries.name: FreeCAD Adaptive2d (Kresimir Tusek)
entries.ships: Ported to TypeScript in src/lib/cam/adaptiveClearing2d/engine/ (each file keeps its SPDX header and copyright)
entries.role: The adaptive-clearing engine (constant-engagement roughing), also used by face, 3D roughing and nesting
entries.thanks: Kresimir Tusek's adaptive clearing is the strategy our users will lean on most - thank you for publishing it openly.

entries.name: OpenCAMLib (Anders Wallin; web build by Koen Schmeets)
entries.copyright: Copyright (c) 2010-2023 Anders Wallin and OpenCAMLib contributors
entries.ships: npm dependency (@opencamlib/opencamlib), unmodified, bundled into the 3D CAM worker
entries.role: Waterline 3D finishing; its drop-cutter method also guided our own 3D kernel
entries.thanks: OpenCAMLib taught a generation of open-source CAM how 3D toolpaths work - thank you.

entries.name: PureCutCNC (Franja Povazanj)
entries.ships: Adapted source in a few files under src/ (each keeps the upstream header and marks our changes); other methods studied and reimplemented with no code copied
entries.role: Engagement-based feed scaling, sketch print-to-paper tiles, gear sketch tool, GRBL conformance harness; methods studied for trochoidal slots, corner relief, pocket ring corners, DXF blocks and post import
entries.thanks: A generous, well-documented open project we learned a great deal from - thank you, Frank.

entries.name: SVGnest (Jack Qiao)
entries.ships: Ported to TypeScript in src/lib/cam/nesting/ (upstream licence kept at src/lib/cam/nesting/vendored/LICENSE.svgnest)
entries.role: True-shape nesting (no-fit polygons and genetic search)
entries.thanks: Thank you for an elegant, open nesting engine that makes sheet layouts possible.

entries.name: Delaunator (Mapbox / Vladimir Agafonkin)
entries.ships: Vendored source, src/lib/cam/vcarve2d/vendor/delaunator.js (version 5.1.0)
entries.role: Delaunay triangulation under the V-carve medial axis
entries.thanks: Fast, tiny and correct - thank you.

entries.name: robust-predicates (Vladimir Agafonkin, after Jonathan Shewchuk)
entries.ships: Vendored source, inside src/lib/cam/vcarve2d/vendor/delaunator.js (version 3.0.2)
entries.role: Exact orientation tests inside Delaunator
entries.thanks: Thank you, and thank you to Jonathan Shewchuk for the original robust predicates.

entries.name: three.js
entries.ships: npm dependency, bundled
entries.role: Every viewport: model, toolpaths, simulation
entries.thanks: The 3D web would be a poorer place without three.js - thank you, mrdoob and contributors.

entries.name: @types/three (DefinitelyTyped)
entries.ships: Type declarations only; used at build time, nothing reaches the app
entries.role: TypeScript types for three.js
entries.thanks: Thank you to the DefinitelyTyped contributors for keeping three.js typed.

entries.name: three-mesh-bvh (Garrett Johnson)
entries.ships: npm dependency, bundled
entries.role: Fast ray casts for 3D finishing and shading
entries.thanks: Thank you for making mesh queries fast enough for CAM.

entries.name: React and React DOM
entries.copyright: Copyright (c) Meta Platforms, Inc. and affiliates
entries.ships: npm dependencies, bundled
entries.role: The whole user interface
entries.thanks: Thank you to the React team and community.

entries.name: Zustand
entries.ships: npm dependency, bundled
entries.role: App state
entries.thanks: Small, clear state management - thank you, pmndrs.

entries.name: Comlink
entries.ships: npm dependency, bundled
entries.role: Talking to the geometry worker
entries.thanks: Thank you for making workers feel like ordinary function calls.

entries.name: fflate
entries.ships: npm dependency, bundled
entries.role: Project file compression, 3MF, archive import
entries.thanks: Thank you for fast, dependency-free compression.

entries.name: Lucide (lucide-react)
entries.copyright: Copyright (c) 2026 Lucide Icons and Contributors; portions Copyright (c) 2013-present Cole Bemis (Feather icons, MIT)
entries.ships: npm dependency, bundled
entries.role: Icons across the UI
entries.thanks: Thank you for a clean, consistent icon set.

licenseTexts.title: Lucide - ISC License (with the Feather MIT notice)

entries.name: ONNX Runtime Web (Microsoft)
entries.ships: npm dependency; its WebAssembly runtime is loaded lazily in the relief-depth worker. It carries Microsoft's own third-party notices, reproduced in THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md
entries.role: Runs the depth model for picture-to-relief
entries.thanks: Thank you for running real models locally, in the browser.

entries.name: i18next and react-i18next
entries.ships: npm dependencies, bundled
entries.role: Looks up the interface's words by key so the app can offer other languages
entries.thanks: Thank you for the translation library half the web runs on.

entries.name: Depth Anything V2 Small (Yang et al.)
entries.copyright: Lihe Yang, Bingyi Kang, Zilong Huang, Zhen Zhao, Xiaogang Xu, Jiashi Feng and Hengshuang Zhao (the Depth Anything V2 authors)
entries.ships: Not in the installer or the web build: downloaded at first use from Hugging Face (the onnx-community ONNX export, pinned by commit) and cached on the user's computer
entries.role: Estimates depth from a photo for Relief
entries.thanks: Thank you for releasing a small, capable model under an open licence.

entries.name: opentype.js
entries.ships: Bundled from the copy three.js ships in its examples (three/examples/jsm/libs/opentype.module.js)
entries.role: Reading user fonts for sketch text
entries.thanks: Thank you for making real font outlines usable on the web.

entries.name: Electron
entries.copyright: Copyright (c) Electron contributors; Copyright (c) 2013-2020 GitHub Inc.
entries.ships: The desktop app's runtime (desktop installer only; LICENSE.electron.txt sits beside the program)
entries.role: The desktop app
entries.thanks: Thank you for the desktop shell that lets one codebase run on three systems.

entries.name: Chromium
entries.copyright: Copyright (c) The Chromium Authors, and the authors of the components listed in LICENSES.chromium.html
entries.ships: Inside Electron, in the desktop installer only; its full notices are LICENSES.chromium.html beside the program
entries.role: The browser engine inside the desktop app
entries.thanks: Thank you to the Chromium authors and to every project whose notice fills LICENSES.chromium.html.

entries.name: Hershey fonts (Dr. A. V. Hershey; packaging by techninja/hersheytextjs and Evil Mad Scientist)
entries.copyright: Public domain (Dr. A. V. Hershey, U.S. National Bureau of Standards, 1967); packaging under MIT
entries.ships: Font data in src/lib/sketch/fonts/hersheySimplex.ts
entries.role: Single-line engraving text
entries.thanks: Thank you to Dr. Hershey's 1967 work, still cutting letters today, and to those who kept it alive.

entries.name: M PLUS Rounded 1c (M+ Fonts Project, Coji Morishita)
entries.copyright: Copyright 2016 The Rounded M+ Project Authors.
entries.ships: ASCII subset bundled as src/lib/sketch/fonts/mplusRounded1cAscii.typeface.json (the copyright line travels inside it); OFL text at src/lib/sketch/fonts/MPLUSRounded1c-OFL.txt
entries.role: Outline sketch text
entries.thanks: Thank you for a friendly, open typeface.

licenseTexts.title: M PLUS Rounded 1c - SIL Open Font License 1.1 (copyright line: Copyright 2016 The Rounded M+ Project Authors.)

entries.name: MgOpen (Helvetiker, Gentilis, Optimer; MAGENTA Ltd.)

entries.ships: The typeface.json files three.js ships in its examples, bundled unmodified
entries.role: Sketch text fonts
entries.thanks: Thank you for releasing these faces for free use.

entries.name: DM Sans

entries.ships: Bundled web font, public/fonts/ (OFL text at public/fonts/OFL.txt)

entries.ships: Bundled web font, public/fonts/ (OFL text at public/fonts/OFL.txt)
entries.role: Numbers and readouts

entries.name: JetBrains Mono
entries.copyright: Copyright 2020 The JetBrains Mono Project Authors
entries.ships: Bundled web font, public/fonts/ (OFL text at public/fonts/OFL.txt)
entries.role: G-code and code text

entries.name: Space Grotesk
entries.copyright: Copyright 2020 The Space Grotesk Project Authors
entries.ships: Bundled web font, public/fonts/ (OFL text at public/fonts/OFL.txt)

entries.name: LinuxCNC
entries.ships: Not shipped; the LinuxCNC gateway talks to a LinuxCNC install the user already has
entries.role: The LinuxCNC gateway talks to its Python interface; RS274NGC behaviour and G10 L2 R rotation measured on its simulator
entries.thanks: Thank you for decades of open machine control and for a simulator we could test against honestly.

entries.name: lcnc-suite (bildobodo)
entries.ships: Not shipped; ideas only, no code copied
entries.role: Ideas for the LinuxCNC gateway
entries.thanks: Thank you for showing a clean way to drive LinuxCNC from outside.

entries.name: GRBL (Sungeun K. Jeon and contributors)
entries.copyright: Copyright (c) 2011-2016 Sungeun K. Jeon; Copyright (c) 2009-2011 Simen Svale Skogsrud
entries.ships: Not shipped; GRBL and grbl-sim run only in a test container
entries.role: Protocol, streaming method and messages we follow; GRBL and grbl-sim validate our posts
entries.thanks: Thank you for the firmware that put CNC in reach of hobbyists.

entries.name: grblHAL (Terje Io)
entries.copyright: Copyright (c) Terje Io and grblHAL contributors
entries.ships: Not shipped
entries.role: The grblHAL post dialect and controller support
entries.thanks: Thank you for carrying GRBL forward to modern hardware.

entries.name: UCCNC and CNCdrive (UC100, AXBB-E)
entries.ships: Not shipped; the bridge is built on the user's own PC against the UCCNC install they already have
entries.role: The controller family LienCAM was first built and tested on; LienCAM drives it through its published API
entries.thanks: Thank you for an open, documented API that let us drive real hardware.

entries.name: NIST RS274NGC interpreter report (Kramer, Proctor, Messina, 2000)
entries.ships: Not shipped; a reference
entries.role: The G-code language reference
entries.thanks: The reference every G-code interpreter still leans on - thank you to its authors.

entries.name: Papers and published methods
entries.ships: Not shipped; methods reimplemented from the published papers
entries.role: Medial axis for V-carve (Brandt and Algazi 1994; Amenta, Bern and Eppstein 1998); Catmull-Clark subdivision (1978) and creases (DeRose, Kass and Truong 1998) for Form; Loop and Schaefer (2008) bicubic patches for exact Form bodies; rotation-minimising frames (Wang et al. 2008) for Form pipes; The NURBS Book (Piegl and Tiller) for splines and knots; Ramer-Douglas-Peucker simplification; Moller-Trumbore ray tests; Zhang-Suen thinning for pencil finishing; marching squares for picture tracing
entries.thanks: Thank you to every researcher who published these methods for others to build on.

entries.name: Machine makers' public specifications
entries.ships: Not shipped; travels and spindle data copied into the example machines
entries.role: Carbide 3D, Sainsmart, Onefinity, Sienci Labs, OpenBuilds, FoxAlien and others: travels and spindle data for the example machines
entries.thanks: Thank you for publishing your specifications.

entries.name: FreeCAD CAM community
entries.ships: Not shipped beyond the Adaptive2d port credited above
entries.role: Beyond Adaptive2d: a long-running open CAM effort we learned from
entries.thanks: Thank you for keeping open CAM alive for so many years.

entries.name: Vite, TypeScript, Vitest, jsdom, Testing Library, Playwright, ESLint, electron-builder, Emscripten, Rust, Docker, Node.js and Git
entries.ships: Not shipped; build and test tools
entries.role: Building, testing and packaging LienCAM (Rust builds the occt-wasm build tool; Emscripten compiles the kernels)
entries.thanks: Thank you to the tools that made a project this size testable.

entries.name: AI coding assistants
entries.ships: Not shipped
entries.role: Help writing, reviewing and testing the code
entries.thanks: Thank you to the AI coding assistants that helped write, review and test LienCAM.
